interest: Shows wartime Peru seeking Japanese-speaking agents for its Japanese colony, and a referred U.S. patent infringement case in Japan.
overview: File 894.52: a 1945 docket indexes an April memo on Peru requesting Japanese-speaking agents for its Japanese colony, and a June entry on Albert White's hooked-rug-machine patent infringement in Japan, referred to a Tokyo attorney.

subfiles.about: Department of State List of Papers sheet indexing a memorandum concerning a Japanese colony in Peru and a Peruvian request for Japanese-speaking agents.
subfiles.summary: Indexes an April memo on Peru's Finance Minister requesting Japanese-speaking agents for its Japanese colony, cross-referenced to 894.20223/127.
subfiles.title: List of Papers entry on Japanese Colony in Peru and request for Japanese-speaking agents

subfiles.about: List of Papers docket entry reporting on an alleged patent infringement in Japan involving a machine belonging to Albert White.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a June entry on Albert White's hooked-rug-machine patent infringement case in Japan, referred to a Tokyo attorney.
subfiles.title: List of Papers entry on patent infringement in Japan of Albert White's machine
